defs.def: used when giving information that you expect other people to know already or agree with （用于陈述认为别人已知道或希望别人同意的事）显然，明显地

ex.s: My perfectionist tendencies were the main root of this: I wanted to be perfect at whatever I did, which obviously in life is not possible, but it consumed me.
ex.t: 我的完美主义倾向是主要原因：我想在所做的任何事情上都做到完美，这在生活中显然是不可能的，但它吞噬了我。

ex.s: Paul Beer, head of rhino section at Port Lympne, said: “Obviously we're all absolutely delighted to welcome another calf to our black rhino family.
ex.t: 波特·林普恩犀牛部门主管保罗·比尔说："显然我们都非常高兴欢迎另一头小犀牛加入我们的黑犀牛家族。

ex.s: A successful swap depends on the selection of clothes, the organization of the event, and, obviously, how much fun is had.
ex.t: 一次成功的交换取决于衣服的选择、活动的组织，当然还有玩得有多开心。

ex.s: Obviously, I was unhappy, but I won’t quit.
ex.t: 显然，我不开心，但我不会放弃。

ex.s: These letters obviously helped sow the seeds of love between the two.
ex.t: 这些信件显然帮助在两人之间播下了爱的种子。

ex.s: However, nearly all avatars are tall, young and nice-looking, so people obviously make their avatars look better than they do in real life.
ex.t: 然而，几乎所有的虚拟形象都是高个子、年轻、长相好看的，所以人们显然让自己的虚拟形象看起来比他们在现实生活中更好。

ex.s: This implies that this man obviously loves routines (and his flowers), and probably waters his flowers every day at the same time.
ex.t: 这意味着这个男人显然热爱日常规律（还有他的花），很可能每天都在同一时间浇花。

ex.s: "Obviously, when your older brother is doing it, you think it's a cool thing to do," says Jonny.
ex.t: "很明显，当你哥哥在做这件事时，你觉得这是一件很酷的事情，"乔尼说。

defs.def: used to say that a particular situation or fact is easy to see or understand （用于说明某种情况或事实明显）显而易见，明显，不言而喻

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是，这些男性在不吃早餐时开始锻炼的血糖水平比吃早餐时更低。

ex.s: One solution is obviously to import foreign workers via immigration.
ex.t: 一个明显的解决方案是通过移民引进外国工人。
